F-t2ia, source-assisted reading. A research reader reread every line of the column on native-size crops of canvas 0, first against the image-only first reading and then with Eneström's print (Bibliotheca Mathematica 3. F. 7, pp. 26-27) at hand. The two lines above the column were understood only after the source was found; "radi(us/is) calefactis circa" there was read with the source in hand. "ascendit(ur)" in the top line follows two blind readers and the coordinator's decision (earlier "accendit(ur)"). Expansions in parentheses, (?) marks doubt, [ ] marks letters not written; ^n^ is the leaf's own interlinear item number. Line numbers count the lines of the column below the two top lines.
